sources: Microsoft Learn: WindowsAI Policy CSP, DisableAIDataAnalysis = 1 ('Turn off saving snapshots for use with Recall') under SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsAI, from Windows 11 24H2 with KB5055627 (26100.3915). According to Microsoft, snapshots already saved are deleted. Recall only exists on Copilot+ PCs; on other devices the setting has no visible effect.
The policy is described in the Policy CSP for Pro, Enterprise and Education; Windows Home reads the same registry value, but Microsoft makes no promise for Home.
